invariants.name: SingleConsumer
invariants.obligation: At most one command executes; a later dequeue waits for terminal receipt or fault publication.

invariants.name: CredentialAuthority
invariants.obligation: Credential replacement is caused only by admitted Login or an eligible current-slot success, after verification and before authenticated publication.

invariants.name: NoResurrection
invariants.obligation: After successful Logout, old completions do not restore credentials or authenticated UI before a later committed Login.

invariants.name: NewLoginIsolation
invariants.obligation: A revoked slot or prior command cannot change a later account's credential or auth projection.

invariants.name: ClearBeforeReceipt
invariants.obligation: Completed Logout records Unauthenticated, no pending request, verified Absent storage and acknowledged SignedOut UI.

invariants.name: PublishAuthority
invariants.obligation: Authenticated publication follows verified matching storage; per-process revisions increase and prior commands cannot publish after later receipts.

invariants.name: AtMostOnce
invariants.obligation: Each slot commits at most once; stale, duplicate and foreign paths preserve the complete managed triple and auth projection.

invariants.name: FaultClosed
invariants.obligation: Unknown storage or failed cleanup cannot produce successful Logout or authenticated publication.

invariants.name: BootstrapClosed
invariants.obligation: A fresh process does not expose persisted credentials before verified bootstrap cleanup.
